definitions.rationale: This macro expands the named generateIntegersBody proof term into the exact translated statement sequence of the Python implementation.
definitions.text:
rule generateIntegersBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    If(
      BoolOp(
        "or",
        ( BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<=", Int(2))),
              Compare(Int(2), CmpOp("<=", Name("b"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp("<=", Int(2))),
              Compare(Int(2), CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          .Exprs
        )
      ),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), (Int(2), .Exprs))),
      .Stmts
    )
    If(
      BoolOp(
        "or",
        ( BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<=", Int(4))),
              Compare(Int(4), CmpOp("<=", Name("b"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp("<=", Int(4))),
              Compare(Int(4), CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          .Exprs
        )
      ),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), (Int(4), .Exprs))),
      .Stmts
    )
    If(
      BoolOp(
        "or",
        ( BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<=", Int(6))),
              Compare(Int(6), CmpOp("<=", Name("b"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp("<=", Int(6))),
              Compare(Int(6), CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          .Exprs
        )
      ),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), (Int(6), .Exprs))),
      .Stmts
    )
    If(
      BoolOp(
        "or",
        ( BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<=", Int(8))),
              Compare(Int(8), CmpOp("<=", Name("b"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          BoolOp(
            "and",
            ( Compare(Name("b"), CmpOp("<=", Int(8))),
              Compare(Int(8), CmpOp("<=", Name("a"))),
              .Exprs
            )
          ),
          .Exprs
        )
      ),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), (Int(8), .Exprs))),
      .Stmts
    )
    Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: This macro defines solutionModule by assembling the function name, parameters, and previously defined implementation body into a Module term.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule =>
    Module(
      FuncDef(
        "generate_integers",
        Params("a", "b"),
        generateIntegersBody
      )
    )

definitions.rationale: This macro defines the named closure value used in the proof target from the function parameters, body, and module environment.
This equation defines the mathematical betweenEndpoints predicate as inclusive containment in either endpoint order.
definitions.text:
rule betweenEndpoints(A, B, D) =>
    (A <=Int D andBool D <=Int B)
      orBool (B <=Int D andBool D <=Int A)

definitions.rationale: This is the true branch of the keepDigit structural helper, defining retention by prepending the selected digit.
definitions.text: rule keepDigit(true,  D, REST) => vCons(D, REST)

definitions.rationale: This is the false branch of the keepDigit structural helper, defining omission by returning the remaining sequence unchanged.
This equation defines the evenDigits mathematical summary as ordered conditional selection of the four even decimal digits.
definitions.text:
rule evenDigits(A, B) =>
    keepDigit(
      betweenEndpoints(A, B, 2),
      2,
      keepDigit(
        betweenEndpoints(A, B, 4),
        4,
        keepDigit(
          betweenEndpoints(A, B, 6),
          6,
          keepDigit(
            betweenEndpoints(A, B, 8),
            8,
            .ValSeq
          )
        )
      )
    )
